missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C011 (partial): Construction or argument, and the full treatment promised by its declared status (proved=annex:p15.bayes-normal-calculation), are not fully supplied. The completing-the-square identity at annex 313-324 is verified only for the theta^2 and theta coefficients. Its theta-free terms produce the factor phi_{tau^2+s^2}(xbar-mu_0) in the body's joint observation density m_n (body 282-288), yet the proof only asserts that they 'agree after putting them over tau^2 s^2 (tau^2+s^2)'. The equality u^2/v + (xbar-mu_0)^2/(tau^2+s^2) = mu_0^2/tau^2 + xbar^2/s^2 is never written out, so the marginal-density claim rests on an unwritten verification step. The posterior, predictive-law, covariance and numerical claims are written.

ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C018 (partial): The definitions are not plainly supplied, and the identified source variant is not preserved. The sequential claim (body 457-459) says 'the cumulative conditional logarithmic score is -log m_n(x_{1:n})'. Neither the entry nor its annex proof (576-578) defines that score: which conditional predictive probabilities r_i are scored, how they are cumulated, or with which sign. The entry defines only the expected logarithmic loss L_p(q) of a single report. The held source at the cited locator (Kass-Raftery sec. 3.2, p. 777) defines the logarithmic score positively, LS = sum_i log pr_i(y_i), with log pr(D|H_k) = LS_k. The entry gives the same-named quantity the opposite sign without recording the change of convention, so the source's form survives only as log m_n = sum_i log r_i at body 183. The finite expected-loss inequality, its equality case and its q(y)=0<p(y) boundary are fully written.

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C011 (partial): The full treatment promised by the declared status (proved=annex:p15.bayes-normal-calculation) is not supplied in written steps. The completed-square identity (theta-mu0)^2/tau^2 + (xbar-theta)^2/s^2 = (theta-u)^2/v + (xbar-mu0)^2/(tau^2+s^2) is checked only for its theta^2 and theta coefficients. The constant term is asserted ('the remaining constants agree after putting them over tau^2 s^2 (tau^2+s^2)', annex 322-324) but never computed. The stated joint density m_n with factor phi_{tau^2+s^2}(xbar-mu0) (body 282-288; annex 331-333) depends on that unwritten step.

ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C018 (partial): The entry's definitions and source variant are not plainly supplied. The entry asserts 'the cumulative conditional logarithmic score is -log m_n(x_{1:n})' (body 457-459) but defines only the expected logarithmic loss L_p(q). The cumulative score is never defined; annex 576-578 only rewrites -log m_n. The cited source's form of the identity is neither preserved nor recorded: Kass and Raftery sec. 3.2 (held PDF p. 6, journal p. 777) define LS = sum_i log p_i(y_i), with log pr(D|H_k) = LS_k and log B_10 = LS_1 - LS_0. That is the opposite orientation, and the entry gives no note of the convention change.

ED26-P15-CH-finite-probability-C010 (partial): The source variant is preserved only through an unsupported source attribution. The entry defines independence for two random variables only (body 231-235). The source's point-mass definition of mutual independence for X_1,...,X_n (Grinstead and Snell sec. 4.1, Definition 4.4) appears on the route only at conditioning-independence-and-information-w02b-p15-006.tex lines 177-180 and 417-418, which cite it at 'p. 142'. In the held CHANCE version, p. 142 (PDF p. 150) carries Definition 4.3; Definition 4.4 is on p. 143 (PDF p. 151).

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C011 (partial): Construction/argument and the full treatment promised by 'proved=annex:p15.bayes-normal-calculation' are not completely written for the stated joint observation density m_n(x_{1:n}). Annex ll. 313-324 verify the square identity only for the theta^2 and theta coefficients, which hold by the definitions of v and u. The one nontrivial part, equality of the theta-free constant terms mu_0^2/tau^2 + xbar^2/s^2 = u^2/v + (xbar-mu_0)^2/(tau^2+s^2), is only asserted ('the remaining constants agree after putting them over tau^2 s^2(tau^2+s^2)'). That equality fixes m_n's factor phi_{tau^2+s^2}(xbar-mu_0). It is not computed and not derived from the cited normal-sum theorem, so it is a sketched step. The posterior normal(u,v), the predictive laws, the covariance v and the numerical case are otherwise written at annex ll. 295-350.

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C011 (partial): The full treatment promised by the declared status 'proved' (proved=annex:p15.bayes-normal-calculation) is not supplied for the stated joint observation density m_n(x_{1:n}) at handbook/parts/p15/bayesian-updating-prediction.tex 280-288. That formula, including its factor phi_{tau^2+s^2}(xbar-mu_0), is obtained only through the square identity at handbook/annex/p15/bayesian-updating-prediction.tex 314-319. Annex 320-324 checks the theta^2 and theta coefficients with reasons, but disposes of the constant terms only by asserting 'the remaining constants agree after putting them over tau^2 s^2 (tau^2+s^2)'. The proof never writes u in closed form, never expands u^2/v and never shows the cross terms cancel. It also does not take the constant from the established thm:p15-normal-sums, whose annex at convolution-gamma-normal.tex 500-527 writes the analogous computation out in full. The argument for the marginal constant is asserted, not written. The posterior, predictive laws, covariance v and numerical case are written at annex 295-349.

ED26-P15-CH-bayesian-updating-prediction-C018 (partial): This entry's definitions are not all supplied, and the source variant is not preserved. The entry defines only the expected logarithmic loss L_p(q) on one finite outcome set (body 444-450). It then asserts 'the cumulative conditional logarithmic score is -log m_n(x_{1:n})' (body 457-459) without defining that score: neither the per-outcome loss -log q(y) nor its sum over the conditional predictive factors r_i is stated. The proof (annex 576-578) silently identifies the score with -sum_i log r_i. The unit's required source extent is Kass-Raftery Secs. 3.1-3.2. The held text there (p. 777; kass-raftery-1995.txt 293-297 and 355-367) defines the logarithmic score as log pr_i(y_i), with LS = sum_i log pr_i(y_i) = log pr(D|H_k) and log B_10 = LS_1 - LS_0, which is the opposite sign. The entry neither adopts that presentation nor says it reverses it.
